verdict.rationale: Accounts receivable tracking is a fair question for accounting software like FreeAgent, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows invoicing features: automated reminders for unpaid invoices, thank-you emails, and dashboard cashflow tracking. None of it documents aging reports or per-customer outstanding balances; payment reminders are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
